Device CRD 2026-06-09 sections 4.1/4.3/12.6 require document-mirrored inline visibility with independent frame suspension and owning XRSessionEvent notifications. See docs/webxr-inline-visibility.md and docs/webxr-inline-visibility-validation-2026-10-24.json for the correction and executed evidence.
